name: AI coding plans
question: Are vendors selling AI coding as a subscription?
metric: Subscription plans for coding tools listed on models.dev, at the start of the month
solvedIf: AI coding is sold like any other flat-rate utility
trendLabel: Coding subscription plans listed on models.dev, at the start of each month. Regional versions of a plan count once.
caution: This counts plans in one community catalogue, so part of the rise is the catalogue adding plans that already existed.
It counts plans, not how many people pay for them, and says nothing about their limits or prices.
rule: More plans when more are listed than a year before.
